name: hu_turn3_stage5_mistake_mining_mc128_1k_plan
purpose: Mine real-play HU Turn3 decision states where the stage3 policy is likely to make high-EV-regret choices, then relabel them with a stronger rollout teacher before stage5 training.

stage3_mistakes.definition: model top1 teacher regret >= 1.0 on the MC128 relabeled teacher set

stage4ft_mistakes.definition: model top1 teacher regret >= 1.0 on the MC128 relabeled teacher set

next_mc2048_run.recommended_target: Relabel 20k-50k mined states with future_samples=2048, then extract regret>=1.0 hard states and train with low source weight.
next_mc2048_run.reason: The local MC128 smoke confirms the selected real-play decision band contains many high-regret choices, but MC128 labels are too noisy for final adoption.

estimated_local_speed.mining: 1000 states in about 9.8 minutes at max_parallel=4
estimated_local_speed.mc128_labeling: 1000 states in about 24.1 minutes at max_parallel=4
estimated_local_speed.mc2048_labeling_estimate: about 16x MC128 labeling time if run locally

next_mc2048_run.training_principle: Do not train only on mistakes. Mix these samples into the existing broad 600k cache with modest weight so the model fixes high-regret holes without destroying the real-play seat-swap EV.

notes: This is not an adoptable model config.
The previous stage4ft model fit the MC2048 boundary shard but lost seat-swap EV against stage3, so stage5 must be validated by seat-swap rather than teacher Top1 alone.
The extraction CLI added in this stage writes original teacher samples with extra mistake_mining metadata, preserving HU teacher schema compatibility for training.
